name: LOADng sequence number freshness
description: Canonical test vectors for LOADng 16-bit sequence number wrap-aware freshness (RFC 1982 serial number arithmetic). Each vector pairs (a, b) and asserts whether b is fresher than a. All three implementations (Rust, Python, C) must agree on every case.

vectors.name: equal_seqs
vectors.description: Equal seq numbers: neither is fresher

vectors.name: simple_increment
vectors.description: b=1 is fresher than a=0 (normal forward increment)

vectors.name: simple_decrement
vectors.description: b=0 is older than a=1 (normal decrement is stale)

vectors.name: backward_100
vectors.description: b=0 is older than a=100 (diff > half, wrap backward considered stale)

vectors.name: half_range_boundary_not_fresher
vectors.description: b=32768 is exactly at the half-range boundary: diff=32768 is NOT < 32768, so not fresher

vectors.name: half_range_just_below_fresher
vectors.description: b=32767 is within the half-range: diff=32767 < 32768, so fresher

vectors.name: wrap_forward_FFFF_to_0000
vectors.description: b=0 wraps forward from a=65535: diff=(0-65535)&0xFFFF=1, fresher

vectors.name: wrap_forward_FFFF_to_0001
vectors.description: b=1 wraps forward from a=65535: diff=2, fresher

vectors.name: wrap_backward_0000_to_FFFF
vectors.description: b=65535 is a huge step backward from a=0: diff=65535 >= 32768, not fresher (would need 65535->0 to be fresher)

vectors.name: wrap_forward_65530_to_5
vectors.description: b=5 wraps forward from a=65530: diff=(5-65530)&0xFFFF=11, fresher

vectors.name: wrap_backward_5_to_65530
vectors.description: b=65530 is a backward wrap from a=5: diff=(65530-5)&0xFFFF=65525 >= 32768, stale

vectors.name: half_to_zero_wrap
vectors.description: b=0 wraps forward from a=32768: diff=(0-32768)&0xFFFF=32768, boundary -> NOT fresher per spec (diff must be < half)

vectors.name: half_minus_one_to_zero_wrap
vectors.description: b=0 wraps forward from a=32769: diff=(0-32769)&0xFFFF=32767 < 32768, fresher

vectors.name: near_half_forward
vectors.description: b=32768 is just over the half boundary from a=32767: diff=1, fresher (but 0->32768 is not)

vectors.name: max_range_minus_one
vectors.description: b=65534 from a=0: diff=65534 >= 32768, not fresher (wrap direction is backward)
